summary: BBN announces a change to how IMPs report status. Text status reports would be removed, since a binary version sent straight to the Network Control Center had already replaced them. The remaining reports from the statistics program would no longer be affected by host parameter-change settings, so hosts cannot accidentally interfere with network monitoring.

plainLanguage.summary: BBN planned to remove text status reports that had been replaced by binary reports to the Network Control Center. It also planned to stop host settings from changing the remaining statistics reports.

subtitle: A planned change to the IMP status reporting facility.

tldr.problem: The IMP's text status reports had become redundant after a binary report was sent directly to the Network Control Center.
tldr.mechanism: BBN planned to remove the text reports and prevent host PARAMETER CHANGE settings from affecting reports in the statistics program on fake host 3.
tldr.outcome: The change was intended to be transparent to hosts and protect NCC reporting from accidental host interference.

today: RFC 218 is an IMP reporting change notice published in September 1971. The unit metadata lists its status as Unknown.

sections.title: Removing Text Reports
sections.content: BBN planned to change the IMP status reporting facility within the next month. Text status reports would be removed because a binary version had already superseded them and was sent directly to the Network Control Center.
sections.plainLanguage: The text reports were no longer needed because the NCC already received a binary version. BBN planned to remove the redundant reports.

sections.title: Protecting NCC Statistics
sections.content:
Status reports would remain with the statistics program on fake host 3. However, hosts would no longer be able to affect those reports through PARAMETER CHANGE settings.

The RFC says this change would prevent hosts from inadvertently interfering with NCC operations. It also says the change should be transparent to hosts.
sections.plainLanguage: The statistics program would remain, but host parameter changes would no longer affect its reports. BBN expected hosts not to notice the change.

sections.title: Timing
sections.content: The notice says the change would take place within the next month. It does not provide further implementation details.
sections.plainLanguage: BBN expected to make the change within the next month.
